positive_snippets:
The place is great for a 3k amount hotel. The service is good and quick, although I did experience delay in one order where they misplaced our order, but mistakes happen from everyone. All other food and services was very quick and good.
I didn't have any trouble staying there. The only thing I might tell others is to take a lower floor room or something, because in the morning there is the declaration of Adhaan, me, I am a heavy sleeper so it doesn't bother me at all... But for light sleepers... The early morning chant might sound a little trouble.
Otherwise the place is great, the staff is great, the food is great(Indian cuisine), there is a terrace, extra bathroom on the outside, the location is the best, since it's so close to the main road, metro gate, etc.
Lovely for someone on a budget.

Rooms are quite decent but a bit smaller compared to google images, but service really makes up for it, overall it was a great experience staying here and plus point is super close to malviya nagar metro

We had a very comfortable stay here. Very good & comfortable for family stay
Hotel staff is supportive and the food is really good & home like and fresh
Walking distance to Max hospital Saket
